connections.title: Connected Instances
connections.description: Link accounts across federated Backspace instances.
connections.empty: No remote instances connected. Add one to start federating.

add.title: Add Remote Instance
add.registrationClosed: This instance has disabled new federated registrations. Existing accounts can still sign in.
add.passwordLabel: Enter your password to connect to {{host}}
add.passwordHint: Your password is checked by your home instance and is never sent to {{host}} — that instance gets a unique credential generated for it alone.
add.fallbackNotice: An account already exists on this instance and it does not accept the credential your home instance issued. Sign in with the password you set on that instance — it will be switched to the issued credential afterwards.

filter.noMatch: No instances match the current filter.

forceRemove.title: Force Remove Entry
forceRemove.description: This will remove the registry entry for {{name}}. The remote instance will not be notified. Use this only if the instance is permanently unreachable.

deleteIdentity.title: Delete Identity
deleteIdentity.description: Remove your federated identity on <name>{{name}}</name>. Choose how your data should be handled.

leave.title: Leave quietly
leave.description: Disconnect from this instance. Your account and all data remain.

soft.title: Delete User
soft.description: Delete your account but keep your messages. You appear as ‘Deleted User’.

full.title: Nuke everything
full.description: Delete your account and all your messages, DMs, reactions, and files. Nothing remains.

pending.title: Pending Peering Approvals
pending.description: Your admin must approve before these requests can proceed.

outcomes.title: Recent Peering Outcomes
outcomes.approved: Your peering request to {{host}} was approved by your admin.
outcomes.denied: Your peering request to {{host}} was denied by your admin.
outcomes.expired: Your peering request to {{host}} expired without admin action.

admin.title: Federation
admin.description: Configure federation relay, secret rotation, and manage peered instances.

relay.title: Relay Settings
relay.description: Control DM relay between federated instances. When enabled, DMs with users on peer instances are relayed server-to-server.

enable.label: Enable DM Relay
enable.description: Relay direct messages to and from peer instances

autoAccept.label: Auto-accept peering
autoAccept.description: Automatically accept peering requests from other instances. When disabled, only manually initiated peering is allowed.

ttl.label: Relay TTL (days)
ttl.description: How long relayed messages are retained in the outbox before cleanup

rotation.label: Default Secret Rotation (days)
rotation.description: Auto-rotation interval for new peers. Existing peers keep their current setting.

confirm.approveOutbound_one: This will initiate a peering handshake with {{name}} on behalf of the {{count}} requesting user. The remote instance must be reachable.
confirm.approveOutbound_other: This will initiate a peering handshake with {{name}} on behalf of the {{count}} requesting users. The remote instance must be reachable.
confirm.approveInbound: This will initiate a peering handshake with {{name}}. The remote instance must be reachable.
confirm.denyOutbound_one: This will deny the outbound peering request and notify the requesting user. They can re-trigger the request from their friend list.
confirm.denyOutbound_other: This will deny the outbound peering request and notify the requesting users. They can re-trigger the request from their friend list.
confirm.denyInbound: This will deny the request and block future auto-peering requests from {{name}}. You can unblock them later from the rejected peers list.

resetCleanup.title: Reset Cleanup
resetCleanup.peerResetDescription: A new instance is running on this domain. Re-establish federation to heal stale friendships and DMs.
resetCleanup.repeerIncomplete: Re-peer incomplete — {{name}} still holds stale peering for you. Its admin must reset their side, then Re-peer again.
resetCleanup.ownsSpaces: {{username}} owns spaces — transfer ownership first (Space Settings → Ownership).
resetCleanup.staleRemote: The remote instance still holds stale peering for you. Ask its admin to reset their side, then Re-peer again.
resetCleanup.eventSummary: <host>{{host}}</host> was reset — {{identities}} auto-cleaned, {{accounts}} with local content detached. Detached accounts keep working locally — owners keep access with their existing password. The owner can re-attach a detached account to their new home identity from that account's settings (Account → detached notice) when logged into both.

confirm.repeerDescription: This deletes the local peer record and starts a fresh authenticated handshake with {{origin}}. The remote must be reachable and (if it does not auto-accept) approve the request.
confirm.removeDescription: Permanently delete {{username}} and all their content on this instance? This cannot be undone.

peers.title: Peered Instances
peers.empty: No federation peers configured. Peers are created automatically when users connect to remote instances.
peers.noMatch: No peers match the current filter.
peers.rotationInitiated: Secret rotation initiated — 15 minute grace period
peers.reinitiateFailed: Peer record deleted but handshake failed: {{error}}. Re-peer manually with {{origin}}

rotate.title: Rotate HMAC Secret
rotate.description: This will generate a new HMAC secret for {{name}}. Both instances will accept old and new secrets during a 15-minute grace period.

revoke.title: Revoke Peer
revoke.description: This will stop all federation relay traffic with {{name}}. Pending outbox entries will be purged. You can re-initiate peering later.

reinitiate.title: Re-initiate Peering
reinitiate.description: This will delete the revoked record and start a fresh handshake with {{origin}}. The remote instance must be reachable.

delete.title: Delete Peer Record
delete.description: This will permanently delete the peer record for {{name}}. This cannot be undone.

reset.title: Reset Peering
reset.description: Reset peering with {{name}}? This deletes the local peer record and all pending outbox entries. You must re-initiate peering with the remote admin out of band after reset. This cannot be undone.
